title: Billboard Latin Women In Music 2026 Recap: Gloria Trevi’s Performance, Becky G’s Selena Tribute & More | Billboard News
summary: Presented by Lexus, Billboard Latin Women In Music 2026 was all about celebrating Latinas who’ve made an impact in the music industry. We got to see Becky G tribute Selena Quintanilla’s “Dreaming of You,” Gloria Trevi accept the Musical Trajectory honor, Young Miko’s Unstoppable Artist honor and more! Keep watching to see everything you missed! […]
